_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY: an invented vendor format showing how to describe the real MQTT format without code. Topic plant/<site>/radiation/<gateway>; each message carries a list of readings in nSv/h with ISO-8601 times; vendor device ids map to devices.json ids. Test with: python scripts/ingest_mqtt.py --file data/mqtt/captured.example.jsonl --dry-run --parser mapping --mapping data/mqtt/mapping.example.json
